capabilities: Save the current note's or all notes' mtimes to plugin settings
Save and restore mtime via a savedModifiedTime note property
Restore changed mtimes selectively through a popup
Exclude notes by path prefix from bulk save and restore
Automatically update saved times daily or on plugin load
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice; the README covers commands and settings but has no screenshots or troubleshooting.
problem: Editing a note's frontmatter or properties updates its file mtime, which destroys the record of when the note content was last actually modified.
summary: Utility that saves and restores notes' last modified times (mtime) so edits like frontmatter changes don't update them.
